newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Gruntal tweaks drugmakers' EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Gruntal tweaks drugmakers' EPS view.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said it raised 1997 earnings projections for Warner-Lambert Co and cut earnings estimates for Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc for the same period.
-- Warner-Lambert 1997 EPS view raised to $3.15 from $3.10 on a better-than-expected new product launch of Lipitor for elevated cholesterol and Rezulin for diabetes.
-- Warner-Lambert shares rose 11/16 to 134-1/2 and touched a new 52-week high of 134-1/2.
-- Cut Pharmacia & Upjohn 1997 EPS estimate to $1.90 from $2.15 to reflect management's guidance owing to struggling operations and poor sales trends.

-- On the drug sector in general, Gruntal said in the report: "We are most bullish on the blue chip drug stock sector and recommend buying a package of several (stocks). The industry has recently entered a new product cycle, introducing a wave of breakthrough drugs that we believe should translate to increased growth and shareholder returns for investors for many years to come.
